Public mapping of token balances in the UniswapExchange token, mutated with unchecked arithmetic.

Internal view sale-limit check against _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.

Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address with attacker-supplied data.

Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum with decimal scaling.

Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress bypass address.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation using keccak256 and init code hash.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner = msg.sender, initial balance and router allowance.
Internal view helper returning msg.sender as address payable.
Private helper performing an arbitrary low-level call to a token address and optional returndata decoding.
